scope: Replace only the threshold load at threshold_load_pc, never the same constant loaded at 0x8029E1F0 for debug stepping. Preserve all original instructions, counter updates, FP exception gates, elapsed time, accumulator and maximum-delta clamp.

runtime_policy.valid_override: Return float(1.0 / parsed_fps) only if original bits equal threshold_bits and disable_variable is absent.

derivation: Read MoM DOL instructions and generated code directly. At 0x8029E230 load accumulator [r29+152], add elapsed f31 at 0x8029E234, store accumulator at 0x8029E238, load 1/60 at 0x8029E23C, compare at 0x8029E240 and skip update on less-than at 0x8029E244. Following instructions retain the existing maximum-delta clamp. No CotT guest address is substituted.
